items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Wooden Hill was a strong trumpet player... I think Wooden Hill was one of the hardest trumpet players they had around Yard.

ctx.x: What about Wooden Hill? How would he compare with Barrage?

Well, I mean, Wooden Hill was a strong trumpet player. But for leading the band, Perez was one of the best. I mean, he used to lead them marches and all. I mean, in other words, he was a musician and all. In other words. But for hardness, for outlasting, I think Wooden Hill was one of the hardest trumpet players they had around Yard.
And what about variations? But Wooden Hill just played straight lead?
